paper.title: Seven temperate terrestrial planets around the nearby ultracool dwarf star TRAPPIST-1
paper.shortTitle: Seven temperate terrestrial planets around the nearby ultracoo
paper.authors: Michael Gillon, Amaury H. M. J. Triaud, Brice-Olivier Demory et al.

thesis: The seven planets have equilibrium temperatures low enough to make possible liquid water on their surfaces.

reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: What phenomenon is supported by the reported observations?

nodes.title: Choose instrument and selection
nodes.body: One focus of modern astronomy is to detect temperate terrestrial exoplanets well-suited for atmospheric characterisation.

nodes.title: Acquire and analyze observations
nodes.body: Our observations reveal that at least seven planets with sizes and masses similar to the Earth revolve around TRAPPIST-1.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: A milestone was recently achieved with the detection of three Earth-sized planets transiting (i.e. passing in front of) a star just 8% the mass of the Sun 12 parsecs away.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: The seven planets have equilibrium temperatures low enough to make possible liquid water on their surfaces.
